item.title: MiMo V2.6 Flash
item.description: MiMo V2.6 Flash is the lower-cost companion to Xiaomi’s MiMo V2.6 Pro, listed on API aggregators in October 2026 with a 128K context window. The exact release date is unconfirmed.
